description: Read-only dependency graph trace (precedents or dependents) rooted at one or more cells in an .xlsx file without evaluating formulas.

input_path.description: Path to the .xlsx file to trace.

request.description: Read-only dependency trace request, e.g. { roots: ['Sheet1!B1'], direction: 'precedents', limits: { max_depth: 2 } }.

direction.description: Trace upstream inputs ('precedents', default) or downstream formulas ('dependents').

max_depth.description: Hop budget (0 = direct neighbors, 2 = two hops).

name: trace_xlsx
title: Trace Formula Precedents & Dependents
